value.summary: Changed lib/render.mjs to render(user, options = {}): the greeting is "Dear" when options.formal === true, otherwise "Hi", with the same `Hi ${user.name}` / `Dear ${user.name}` interpolation. Calling render(user) with one argument takes the default {} and produces exactly the previous output. Only lib/render.mjs was modified, per the declared write target; the existing test was not touched.

observations.statement: render() now honors an optional options object; formal mode is selected only by options.formal === true, so undefined, {}, and formal:false all preserve the legacy informal output.

evidenceCandidates.statement: Implementation branch for options.formal === true returns `Dear ${user.name}`; test-level evidence comes from T002 and the acceptance command in the verify task.
The one-argument path is unchanged (options defaults to {}), so the pre-existing informal test should still pass; final verification belongs to API-C01-A.
